tei:div.tei:p: rang bzhin yon tan rgyan gyi phul/ /bla na med pas legs brgyan slad/ / gzhan gyi bcos ma'i rgyan rnams kyis/ /brgyan par bgyi yang ci zhig 'tshal/ / de lta mod kyi 'phags mchog dang*/ /'gro mchog rnams kyi nyin dang nyin/ / bstod pa'i rgyan gyis rnam kun tu/ /brgyan par bgyid pa ma lags sam/ /de slad bdag kyang mchod pa dang*/ /sna tshogs bstod pa'i sgra dbyangs kyi/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis mgon po khyod/ /kun tu brgyan phyir spobs par gyur/ /'di ltar mchod pas mchod par bgyir 'os ma lus kun bdag mgon po mchog khyod mchod sprin rgya mtsho snyan tshig char rgyun bstod dbyangs 'brug gi sgra dbyangs ldan pas legs mchod pas/ /de ltar mchod pas mchod byed du 'os ma lus lus can chos kyi dbyings gtugs nam mkha'i mthas klas kun gyis kyang ni kun bzang rnam 'phrul mchod sprin lta bus legs mchod cing*/ /yon tan rgya mtsho'i yon tan tshogs rnams yon tan shes pa'i dad pas dbang byas yon tan bsngags pa'i bstod dbyangs rgya mtsho dbyangs can (《

lu 》 snyan ) tshig dang tshangs dbyangs ltar snyan legs bsgrags pas/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho rnam par sbyangs nas bsod nams rgya mtsho kun nas rgyas pa'i dpal las legs byung mchod sprin rgya mtshos yon tan rgya mtsho sras bcas rtag tu mchod gyur cig /gcig la mchod pas mchod 'os kun/ /kun nas mchod par 'gyur ba ste/ /dngos grub bde blag nyid stsol bas/ /yul 'di bla na med par 'tshal/ /ngo bo rnam dag bkod pa rmad/ /sems kyi rnam 'phrul phul byung bas/ /zhing kun rgyas par 'gengs pas na/ /mchod rdzas dam pa nyid lags grang*/ /dmigs pa med bzhin gzhan don dmigs/ /snyan dngags snyan pa'i bstod dbyangs bcas/ / gus pas 'dud bzhin gus mchod pa'i/ /tshul 'di chos tshul ma lags sam/ / phyag 'os phyag dang mchod pas mchod slad bdag dang gzhan gyis tshul min bgyis pa'i nongs pa gang de slan chad bsdam pa'i yid kyis bshags/ /dge dang dge 'bras gang dang gang yod de dang de la dga' bas yi rangs dge legs rgya mtsho kun tu spel slad rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /gang dang gang bzhugs de dang de la 'khor lo rin chen bskor bar bskul zhing 'khor ba ji srid brtan par bzhugs gsol de dag gis/ /ji lta ji ltar spyod pa spyad pa de lta de ltar gzhan gyi don phyir bdag gis spyad bgyi ma lus skye rgu'ang spyod gyur cig /byang chub spyod pa'i yan lag yan lag bdun/ /bdag gis ji ltar spyad pa spyod pa ltar | | skye rgu kun gyis spyod pa spyad byas nas/ /rang byung rgyal ba lha yi lhar gyur cig | mchod 'os yon tan rgya mtsho legs mchod pa'i/ /dge des 'gro kun mchod bya'i gnas thob nas/ /de dag kun la mchod sprin rgya mtsho yis/ /mchod byaid kun tu bzang po bdag gyur cig /bstod 'os rnams la bstod dbyangs snyan pa'i sgras/ /bstod pa'i dge ba gang des lus can kun/ /bstod byar gyur nas de dag rnams la bdag /stod byed snyan dngags mkhan du'ang 'gyur

bar shog /bdag kyang skye zhing skye ba thams cad du/ /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras po thams cad la/ /bla med mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod byed cing*/ /bstod dbyangs rgya mtsho'i sgra yis bstod par shog /mthong ba'i chos (《 zha 》 tshe ) 'dir chos la rab dad pa'i/ /chos rgyal chos kyis rgyal zhing zhabs brtan la/ /chos bzhin chab srid legs skyong skye rgu kun/ /chos dang zang zing dpal gyis 'byor par shog /'dir ni chos don phun tshogs pa/ /yang dag spobs pas dbang byas nas/ /tshig sbyor snyan pas bsdebs pa gang*/ /dbyangs kyi kun nas bsnyad pa'i tshe/ /'phags pa'i tshogs rnams dgyes 'gyur zhing*/ /blo gsal rnams kyi yid 'phrog la/ /blun po'i rna ba'i dpal bskyed pa/ /'di 'dra so so rig pa'i rgyu | | tshig gi sdeb sbyor sbyor ba'i tshul la tshul bzhin shes pa'i shes ldan zhing*/ / don gyi rin chen chen po'i chen pos ches cher mdzes byed sna tshogs kyis/ /gang blo'i khang mdzes mdzes par rab spras spros pas spros pa'i yid dbang phyir/ / gzhan gyi snyan dngags ngag gi dpal 'phrog 'phrog byed yid rab 'phrog pa sbyar | | kun+da'i phreng ba kun nas bstar 'dra'i so yi ze'u 'bru'i phreng ba can/ / dkar nag rnam 'byes gsal ba'i mdangs ldan mig gi pad 'dab rnam par rgyas | | rab tu dga' ba'i rlung gi shugs kyis ro 'dzin snying po bskyod pa las/ / snyan tshig dri bsung phyogs bcur khyab pas shes ldan bung ba'i yid rab 'phrog / tshul 'di mkhyen rab rgya che rab rgyas kun nas brtse ba'i thugs mnga' ba'i/ / chos kyi rgyal po bzang po'i zhabs kyi zhabs pad spyi bos gus blangs shing*/ /blo gros rgyal mtshan yon tan nor bu'i dpal gyis mtshan pa legs 'dzin pa/ / theg pa mchog gi brtul zhugs bzang pos rnam par 'phags pas sbyar ba yin/ khams gsum gyi chos kyi rgyal po bla ma bde bar gshegs pa la/ chos gos rin po che 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rgyan rnam par bkram pa zhes bya bas mchod par byed pa'i rab tu bsngags pa/

bstod dbyangs rgya mtsho snyan dngags rin po che'i rgyan rnam par bkra ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dge slong chos smra ba blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes bya bas/ sa mo lug gi lo dgun zla 'bring po la/ rgya nag po'i rgyal po grangs med pa byung ba'i gnas bkra shis dang*/ dge mtshan du mas rnam par brgyan pa cong to'i mkhar chen por sbyar ba'o/ /tshul 'di ni rkang pa thung ngu dang*/ ring po dang*/ shin tu ring po rnams spel zhing 'byung bas rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs kyi phreng ba lta bu zhes bya ba'i sdeb sbyor yin la/ 'di'i don dran bzhin pa'i dbyangs rnam par dag pas brjod cing gzhan dag la'ang bsnyad na/ rgya che ba'i bsod nams kyi phung po nye bar bskrun par 'gyur ro snyam du'ang bsams mod/ de lta na'ang tshu rol mthong ba byis blo'i ngang tshul du gyur pas tshig dang*/ don gyi cha la 'gal ba dang*/ 'khrul par gyur pa de dang de dag legs par sbyangs pa'i thugs shin tu dwangs pa'i me long ltar gsal bar shes bya'i dkyil 'khor gyi gzugs brnyan kun tu snang ba/ shin tu mkhas pa'i skye bo rnams dang*/ dam pa'-i don gyi de kho na nyid la shin tu mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor la goms pas/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes shin tu gzi che ba brnyes pa'i 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams kyi thugs kyis bas par 'gyur ba ni/ shin tu gnong ba'i yid kyis bzod par gsol zhing mchis pas/ rigs pa dang rnam par grol ba'i spobs pa rdo rje'i ngag phyin ci ma log pa'i don dang bcas pa'i dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol lo// //༄༅/ /thub pa'i bstod pa bzhugs/¿/ ༄༅/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i bstod pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dri med dad pa'i chu gter las 'khrungs pa/ /tshig gi me tog snyan pa'i dri bsung can/ /ngag gi srad bus tshar du dngar byas nas/ /thub dbang yon tan rgya mtshor mchod par bgyi

| | 'gro ba 'di kun sna tshogs sdug bsngal gyis/ /kun nas gzir bar gang gis mkhyen gyur pas/ /de dag bsgral phyir byang chub thugs bskyed pa/ / phan par dgongs pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srid pa'i bde la kun nas ma zhen par/ /byang chub mchog phyir rab tu brtson pa yis/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rab rdzogs mdzad pa/ /brtson pa mtha' yas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / ma chags nyes med mi 'khrugs rab tu sdud/ /rnam par mi g.yeng kun nas ma rmongs dang*/ /thabs stobs smon lam ye shes rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /yongs su rdzogs pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dran dang brtson 'grus rdzu 'phrul rkang pa dang | | dbang po mchog dang rmad du byung ba'i stobs/ /byang chub yan lag 'phags pa'i lam rnams kun/ /legs par grub pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / grangs med gsum gyis sa bcu mthar phyin nas/ /lha rnams gdul bar bya phyir dga' ldan du/ /dam pa tog dkar zhes byar gang gyur pa/ /bsod nams mtha' yas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus mkhyen khyod ni lhums su bde bar bzhugs | | ∶lhums nas (《 lu 》 bde bar ) bltams shing gzhon nu'i rol rtsed mdzad | | mngon par byung nas dka' ba rab tu spyad/ /don kun grub pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub shing dbang drung du bdud kyi stobs/ /byams pa'i thugs kyis legs par pham mdzad nas/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun gyis dbang bskur ba/ /dpa' bo chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mngon par shes pa lnga ni legs bsgrubs nas/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin mchog gis ni/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub brnyes gyur pa/ /'jig rten 'dren pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo | | bag chags dang bcas dri ma kun spangs shing*/ /mkhyen pa'i ye shes kun nas rab rgyas pas/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten kun gyi skyabs gyur pa/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spros pa nye bar zhi ba'i rang bzhin can | | nges pa lnga ldan bde chen ye shes sku/

/gzhan gyi rkyen gyis sna tshogs kun snang ba/ /sku gsum brnyes pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lhun po'i rgyal po lta bur rab tu brjid/ /nyi ma bzhin du mtha' yas 'od mdzad cing*/ /mtshan dang dpe byad kun nas gsal ba'i sku/ /mgon po mtshungs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / don bzang chos spobs nges pa'i tshig ldan pas/ /'khor gyi nang du 'jigs bral seng ge'i sgra/ /dbyangs kyi yan lag drug cus rab brgyan pa/ /kun tu sgrogs pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsal zhing thogs med mi gnas mnyam pa nyid/ / yon tan 'byung gnas gdul bya'i don kun sgrub/ /rtog pa kun spangs srid dang zhi ba'i bdag /ye shes lnga ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten slob ma bse ru lta bu dang*/ /rgyal sras rnams dang thun mong gyur pa dang*/ /phul du byung ba'i yon tan kun brnyes pa/ /srid zhi'i ston mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / kun sbyor 'ching ba kun las rnam grol yang*/ /smon lam grub pa rnam 'phrul mtha' yas kyis/ /srid pa ji srid 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /skye rgu'i gnyen gcig khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor lo rin chen dam pa skor mdzad cing*/ / shin tu gdul dka'i skye bo rab tu btul/ /gdul bya rnam grol gsum la 'god mdzad pa/ /stobs bcu ldan pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdul bya rnams kyi skal ba'i dus mkhyen nas/ /bstan pa 'phags pa'i tshogs la legs gtad de | | ku sha'i grong du zhi ba'i tshul bstan pa/ /sdug bsngal mthar mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /slar yang 'gro ba'i bsod nams spel bya'i phyir/ /sku gdung ring bsrel phung por legs gyur nas/ /'jig rten kun gyi mchod pa'i rten gyur pa/ /mdzad pa rgyun mi 'chad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gan+dha ra yi grong*/ /ka ∶liṅga (《 lu 》 ling ka ) dang klu yi gnas rnams su/ /bsod nams rten du nyid kyis rjes gnang ba'i/ /thub chen mche ba bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/

/ bsod nams shugs ldan snying rje'i ngang tshul can/ /go pe la yi lhag bsam dag pa'i mthus/ /'gro ba gdul phyir nye bar byon gyur pa/ /rgyal ba'i tshems la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji ltar nyi mas lus 'phags snang byas nas/ / 'dzam gling snang bar byed ltar 'jang gi yul/ /snang bar mdzad nas 'dir ni snang mdzad pa/ /skye rgu'i sgron ma de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dzam bu chu bo'i gser ltar rab tu dwangs/ /kun+da ltar dkar gur gum mdangs ldan pas/ /mdzes pa gzhan kun rab tu zil gnon pa/ /mchod par 'os pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ / bde gshegs yon tan rgya mtshor skye ba brnyes/ /phan bde'i 'od zer sna tshogs rab tu 'phro/ /gsol ba btab na dgos 'dod kun 'byung ba/ /dbang gi rgyal po de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /slar yang bdag la gsol ba'i tshig 'ga' mchis/ / 'jig rten mgon po yud tsam dgongs su gsol/ /mgon med 'di dag nga yis bskyab bo zhes/ /dam bcas ji bzhin nyid kyi rjes dgongs la/ /las kyi rlung gis srid pa'i rgya mtshor 'phangs/ /blo gros mi bral nyon mongs dbang gyur pa'i | | 'gro kun sdug bsngal rnams las skyabs pa dang*/ /rnam grol bde chen thob par mdzad du gsol/ khyod kyi bstan pa dri med tshul 'di ni/ /'gro ba kun gyi mig gcig gyur pa lags/ /de lta mod kyi blo ngan ma sbyangs shing*/ /gzu lums smra ba chos ltar bcos pa yi/ /skye bo rnams kyis rab tu dkrugs par gyur | | tshul 'di mgon po khyed kyis rab bzlog nas/ /bde gshegs bstan pa rma med rgyas pa dang*/ /'gro ba kun la rtag tu snang bar mdzod/ /deng sang 'di na 'gro ba'i dpal 'byor dang*/ /thub pa'i bstan pa gang la brten pa'i gzhi/ / mong go rgyal po mi dbang go pe la/ /sku mched yab sras brgyud par bcas pa kun | | sku tshe ring zhing dbang phyug rgyas pa dang*/ /thub dbang khyod kyi gsung rab bdud rtsi yi/ /snod kyi dam pa nyid du 'gyur ba dang*/

/chos bzhin 'jig rten rtag tu skyong bar mdzod/ /char chu dus su 'bab cing lo tog legs/ /nad dang mu ge 'khrug pa zhi ba dang*/ /phan tshun byams pa'i sems dang rab tu ldan/ / 'gro ba dpal dang ldan par mdzad du gsol/ /bde gshegs dbang po yon tan gter gyis phyug /mtha' yas phyir na mtha' dag sus brjod spobs/ / gsol ba 'di dag bdag 'dra'i spyod yul min/ /'on kyang cung zad tsam zhig 'dir brjod pas/ /rgyal sras go pe la yi dad pa'i mthus/ /thub chen mche ba mthong bar gyur pa la/ /rab tu dga' zhing dad pa'i dbang gis brjod/ /bdag blo'i nyes pa deng 'dir bzod par gsol/ /de las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ni | | dri med rab tu dkar ba gang yod des/ /nam mkha'i mthas gtugs gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang ∶la gnas (《 lu 》 thob par ) shog /gnas skabs su yang mi dbang go pe la/ /sras dang btsun mo nad med sku tshe ring*/ /bde gshegs bstan pa rgyas par byed pa dang*/ /byams pa'i thugs kyis 'gro ba skyong bar shog /bdag kyang deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa legs bzung nas/ /chos kyis phongs pa'i sems can thams cad la/ /mtshungs med chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed par shog /mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor legs bshad 'od zer can/ /shes bya'i mkha' la kun tu thogs med cing*/ /gdul bya'i blo gros pad tshal rgyas mdzad pa | | chos rje chos kyi nyi ma la phyag 'tshal/ /shākya'i rgyal po'i yon tan gyi cha la bstod cing gsol ba'i tshig 'di ni/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i ∶gsung gi 'od zer gyis yid kyi mun pa bsal bar byas pas/ thub pa'i gsung rab kyi cha la blo'i snang ba cung zad thob par gyur pa chos smra ba'i btsun pa (《 zha 》 zhabs kyi rdul spyi bos len pa ) 'phags pa zhes bya bas de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshems mche ba mthong bar gyur pa la dad cing mngon par dga' bas/

shing pho stag gi lo smin drug gi zla ba'i tshes nyi shu gsum la sbyar ba'o// //༄༅/ /'jam dpal la mtshan don gyi sgo nas bstod pa ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + tshigs bcad nyer lnga pa ) bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ skyabs mchog sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ /dpal ldan bla ma la btud de/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa'i yab/ /'jam pa'i dpal la bstod par bgyi/ /ming la brten nas don tshol ba/ /'di ni shes ldan rnams kyi lugs/ /thub pas khyod mtshan 'jam dpal zhes/ /bsgrags don de ni 'di ltar khums/ /sems kyi rang bzhin spros pa yi/ /grwa zur zhi bas 'jam pa nyid/ /rten 'byung srid zhi'i dpal gyi gzhi/ / 'di 'dra rgyu yi 'jam dpal lags/ /stong nyid rtogs pas lta ba yi/ /tshang tshing zhi bas 'jam pa nyid/ /snying rjes ∶skye 'gro'i (《 lu 》 'gro ba'i ) dpal gyur pa/ / 'di 'dra lam gyi 'jam dpal lags/ /sku gsum mi phyed mnyam sbyor zhing*/ / sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /yon tan phrin las mthar phyin pa/ /'di 'dra 'bras bu'i 'jam dpal lags/ /chos dbyings rang bzhin 'jam pa'i ngang*/ / gzugs kyi sku ni gdul bya'i dpal/ /sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa po/ /'jam pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun nas mdzes pa 'jam pa'i sku/ /mtshan dang dpe byad nyer 'bar ba/ /gang gis mthong ba'i dpal gyur pa/ /'jam pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /theg mchog ston pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /yan lag drug cus zug rngu sel/ /gang gis thos pas dpal gyur pa/ /'jam pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgrib gnyis dri bral 'jam pa'i thugs/ /ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid can/ /gang gis dran pa'i dpal gyur pa/ /'jam pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srid zhi mnyam nyid 'jam pa ste/ /stobs dang mi 'jigs rig pa sogs/ /gang gis rjes su slob pa'i dpal/ /'jam pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro la mnyam dgongs 'jam pa nyid/ /rnam 'phrul du mas rnam kun tu/
/gang gis dad pa'i dpal gyur pa/ /'jam pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo

| | de ltar rgyu dang lam dang ni/ /'bras bu'i chos rnams gang lags pa/ /de kun 'jam pa'i dpal nyid de/ /rnam par spros na mtha' yas lags/ /de slad dus gsum rgyal ba kun/ /'jam dpal gyis bskyed ces dang*/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /gcig tu bsdus pa 'jam dpal zhes/ /gsungs pa'ang nges pa'i don du 'tshal/ /rgyal ba ming dang mtshan ma yi/ /tshul du gang btags de yis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ma mthong la/ /gang gis tshul 'dis sangs rgyas kun/ /'jam dpal nyid du legs rtogs pa/ /de yis rgyal ba'i nges pa'i sku | | gdon mi za bar 'tshal ba lags/ /de slad gaṅgā'i rdul snyed kyi/ /thub mtshan bskal par brjod pa bas/ /'jam dpal zhes brjod khyad 'phags zhes | | gang gsungs de yang nges par khums/ /rga dang 'chi ba'i 'jigs bral dang | | tshangs spyod chos kun gnas med dang*/ /gzhan gyi don la rtse dga'i phyir | | gzhon nur gyur pa khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /bdud dang gshin rje'i 'jigs pa kun/ /ma rig pa las byung ba ste/ khyod kyis de yang dpy-is 'byin pas | | gshin rje'i dgrar gyur khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sku yi mtshan dang rnam pa dang*/ kha dog dang ni phyag 'tshan dang*/ /cha lugs gsung gis gsang sngags kun/ / gdul bya'i rgyud la zab mo'i don/ /mtshon pa'i phyir dang thob bya'i phyir/ /sgyu ma'i tshul gyis rnam sprul pa/ /'di 'dra rgyal ba thabs mkhas pa/ /bsam mi khyab pa'i rnam 'phrul lags/ /de slad de la rnam kun tu/ /spy-i bos gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing*/ /bsam pa thag pas skyabs su mchi/ /rtag tu byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ khyod kyi rang bzhin ji bzhin dang*/ /rnam 'phrul mdzad pa ji snyed pa/ /'phags mchog rnams kyi'ang yul min na/ /bdag 'dras ji ltar rtogs par 'gyur/ /'on kyang bsam mi khyab pa dang*/ /mtshungs med dpe med zla med cing*/ /dpag yas nyid du legs khums pas/ /de lta'i tshul gyis bsngags pa lags/ khyod kyi mtshan las khyod yon tan/

/brtags nas tshig gi phreng bas bstod/ /don dang mi ldan rjes bsngags pa/ /sgro 'dogs yin phyir smad pa'i gnas(《 zha 》 phyir ) / /rgya mtsho las ni byung ba'i chus/ /rgya mtsho'i lha ni mchod pa ltar/ /rgyal ba'i gsung las 'byung ba yi/ /tshul gyis khyod la bsngags pa lags/ /'di la sdeb sbyor ma mchis shing*/ /gal te don yang 'gal gyur na | | brtse bas bzod par dgongs nas kyang*/ /'khrul pa'i dra ba bral du gsol | | dad pas brjod slad dge bsags pa/ /gang yin de yis 'gro ba kun | | blo mchog 'jam mgon rjes zhugs nas/ /'jam pa'i dpal du 'gyur bar shog /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la mtshan don gyi sgo nas bstod pa | tshigs su bcad pa nyi shu rtsa lnga pa 'di ni/ chos kyi rgyal po dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i zhabs rdul spy-i bos len pa/ 'phags pa'i ming dang ldan pas/ me mo sbrul gyi lo dbyar zla 'bring po'i tshes bcu bdun la ri bo rtse lngar sbyar ba'o || || ༄༅/ /'jam dpal la ¡Ã nye bar bsngags pa ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· bstod pa ) me tog gi phreng ba bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhṃ/ na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ shes bya kun mkhyen chos kyi rgya mtsho tshig dang spobs pa'i rin chen ting 'dzin rgyal ba dang*/ /rgyal sras rang rgyal dgra las rnam rgyal 'jig rten gtso bo che bar rab grags de dag gis | | yon tan dpag yas 'jam pa'i dbyangs la bstod dbyangs bgrang yas rtag tu sgrogs mod de lta na'ang*/ /mchog tu dad pas ji ltar spobs bzhin bdag gis kyang ni bstod tshig me tog phreng bas mchod/ /rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes las grub rgyal sras gzhon nu rnam par rol pa 'gying pa'i sku/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rtag tu bskor phyir chos 'chad phyag rgyas ∶thugs rje (《 zha 》 rjes su ) mtshon byed ut+pal bsnams/ /dpa' bo khyod ni bdud bzhi'i dpung 'joms mthu stobs brnyes slad rab tu 'bar ba'i ral gri dang*/

/ye shes gsal ba'i skad cig gcig gis shes bya ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen phyir glegs bam 'dzin/ / rang gzhan don gyi yon tan ma lus yongs su rdzogs slad gser bzang 'bar ba'i mdangs ldan pa/ /rin chen gyis spras na bzas klubs shing rnam pa sna tshogs sprul pa'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'gyed/ /bsod nams yongs rdzogs nyes pas ma gos rang bzhin gyis gsal mi 'jigs bzhi yis bsnyengs bral bas | | rin chen khri steng chu skyes bsil zer rnam par bsgy-ings pa'i seṅge mchog la rol pas bzhugs/ /chos kyi dbyings dang nyid kyi rigs mtshon mthon mthing ral pa'i thor tshugs mi 'khrugs rgyal bas brgyan/ /spyan mchog bzang pos 'gro la legs gzigs 'dzum pa'i mdangs ldan zhal gyi pad+mo rgyas pa las/ / dam pa'i chos sgra bsgrags pa'i dris bsdus rgyal sras rang rgyal dgra bcom bung ba nyer 'khrigs pas/ /nye bar bsngags pa'i dar dir sgra sgrogs lha dang klu dbang rig 'dzin chos (《 zha 》《 lu 》 tshogs ) kyis khyod zhabs mchod/ /bcom ldan khyod ni la la dag na zla ba nya ltar rab tu zhi zhing des pa dang*/ /'ga' zhig tu ni rgyan rnams du mas rnam par spras shing nyi ma bzhin du rab tu lham/ /gzhon nu la lar btsun mo'i 'khor gyis rnam par rol zhing bde ba kun la dgyes rgur spyod | | gzhan du 'jigs byed mi bzad tshul 'dzin dus mtha'i me 'od mched pa ltar 'bar phreng bas 'khrigs/ kha cig tu ni yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing dang sman sogs 'gro ba'i nyer 'tshor 'gyur/ /la lar gdong bzhi drag po 'jug sred dbang po dang ni 'khor los sgyur rgyal tshul ston zhing*/ /de bzhin gzhan du dgra bcom rang rgyal rgyal sras du ma'i rnam par bstan nas gzhan yid sgyur/ /zhing khams la lar rnam par 'dren pa chen por gyur nas rin chen chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /mgon po khyod kyi rnam 'phrul mtha' yas rgyal bas kyang ni brjod par nus min gang gi phyir/

/nam mkha' dang ni chos kyi dbyings dang sems can khams bzhin tshad dang bgrang ba las 'das phyir/ /dbyangs dang gsal byed yi ge'i ma mo brgya phrag phyed rnams bcom ldan khyod kyis gsang sngags lags/ /de dag las btus sdeb sbyor tha dad las rnams kun byed dpag tu med mod chos kyi sgo/ /skye med rdul bral don dam de nyid 'chi 'pho med cing mi 'bral mtshon byed yi ge lnga/ khyod kyi sngags kun bzang mo'i de nyid nges par mtshon phyir chos rnams kun gyi snying po lags/ khyod nyid gcig pu sa gsum dag na rmad du byung bar yongs su grags gyur de slad du/ /skye bo gang zhig bag yod de dag gdon mi za bar khyod la skyabs su mchi bar bgyid/ /gang gis lugs bzang dri med de 'dra bla ma'i drin gyis legs par khums pas bdag gi yid/ /dad pa'i blo gros rnam par 'phel slad mgon po khyod kyi zhabs kyi drung du nye bar lhags/ khyod kyi rnam 'phrul mtha' yas ji snyed bdag gi lus kyang de snyed gyur nas khyod bzhugs srid/ /mchod pa'i sprin phung nye bar bkod pa du mas mchod cing spyi bo'i gtsug gis phyag 'tshal lo/ /sdug bsngal du mas rab tu nyen pa'i 'gro kun bskyab slad nges pa kho nar skyabs su mchi/ /ma rig gis ldongs las kyi rlung gis sdug bsngal rba 'khrugs srid pa'i rgya mtshor rab 'phangs nas/ /nyon mongs chu srin mi bzad khar chud skye rgu'i 'di dag thugs rje'i phyag gis legs drangs te/ /thar pa dam pa'i dge legs dpal gyis rnam par rol phyir rnam pa kun tu gsol ba 'debs/ /thub pa'i gsung rab shin tu gces phyir nyid kyis kyang ni glegs bam rtag tu bsnams mdzad na'ang*/ /deng sang 'di na che bar khas 'che de dag gis kyang ∶sde snod (《 zha 》 sdebs sbyor ) rgya mtsho rgyang bsrings nas/ /gdams pa'i thigs pa cung zad tsam la mchog tu lta zhing dam chos smra ba sun 'byin pas/

/'gro ba 'di kun mun nag stug pos mngon par khebs gyur 'di la mgon khyod ji ltar dgongs/ /skye rgu 'di dag ma rungs gyur pa mngon sum mthong bas bdag yid bzod par ma gyur pas/ khyod las gzhan pa'i re gnas ma mchis de yi slad du bsam pa thag pas gsol btab kyang | | gal te khyod thugs dgongs mi mdzad na khyod kyi mthu dang thugs rje'i bya ba gang zhig lags/ /de slad de ltar gsol ba'i don 'di da lta nyid du 'bras bu mchog dang ldan pa mdzod/ /mgon po 'jam dbyangs ye shes rgya mtshor bstod dbyangs tshig gis sa bon rnam par btab pa las/ /bdag blo'i nyes pa'i 'dam gyis ma gos bsod nams pad+mo bde legs bcud ldan gang bskrun pa | | nam mkha'i mthas gtugs skye rgu'i bung bas dga' mgur spyad pas nyon mongs kyis gzir rgud bral nas/ /bsod nams lus rgyas ye shes lnga yi bde ba mchog dang rnam pa kun tu ldan gyur cig /blo mchog 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' bzhin du lus can kun la khyab par bzhugs mod de lta na'ang*/ /rang gi nyes spyad dbang du gyur pas sdug bsngal khung zhugs blo gros mig bral stobs zhan pas/ /bcom ldan mthong dang thos pa'i skal med rnam par 'thoms pa de 'dra'i drung du bdag mchis nas/ /rnam 'phrul bye ba phrag brgya bstan nas khyod kyi legs bshad bdud rtsi'i dga' ston thob byed shog /chos kyi rgyal po sa skya pa zhes grags pa'i 'od kyis sa gsum rab gsal bla ma de'i/ /zhabs kyi pad+mo cod pan du byed 'phags pa'i ming can blo gros gsal ba'i mig ldan pas/ / bstod tshig me tog sdeb sbyor mdangs bkra kun nas spel legs snyan pa'i dri bsung dang ldan pas/ /blo gsal bung ba'i yid rab 'phrog byed me tog phreng 'dis mgon po 'jam dbyangs legs mchod do/ /'di ltar byang chub sems pa'i spyod pa la ring du sbyangs pas bstan pa'i bya ba dang*/ gzhan gyi don la rab tu brtson pa'i go bgos pa/

rgyal po go pe la zhes bya ba'i bsod nams kyi dpal la mngon par brten nas chos smra ba 'phags pa zhes bya bas/ ri bo rtse lngar mchis nas 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gsol ba btab pa'i tshe/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam par 'phrul pa du ma bstan pas bstod par 'dod pa'i blo gros rnam par ∶'phel ba (《 zha 》 'phrul pa ) dang*/ gzhan yang thar pa chen po'i rgyal mtshan rab tu bsgreng zhing*/ mngon par mtho ba'i dpal 'byor bzang pos skye rgu'i tshogs bde legs su bya ba'i phyir/ ri bo rtse lnga de nyid du me mo sbrul gyi lo/ zla ba bdun pa'i tshes brgyad la nye bar bsngags pa me tog gi phreng ba zhes bya ba sbyar ba 'di yongs su rdzogs so// //༄༅/ /'jam dbyangs la ¡Ã ri bo rtse lngar bstod pa ( ¡¶ lu ¡· - ri bo rtse lngar bstod pa ) nor bu'i phreng ba bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ na mo mañdzu nā thā ya/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes rgya mtshor 'khrungs/ /mkhyen pa'i 'od gsal dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhing*/ /lhar bcas 'gro ba'i gtsug gi rgyan gyur pa/ /bla ma rin chen zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo | | ye shes rang bzhin rin chen las grub pa'i/ /'jam mgon lhun po'i ngang gi mdzes mod kyang*/ /bdag yid rab tu dad pas bstod pa'i tshig /nor bu'i phreng bas brgyan phyir bsdeb par bgyi/ /drang srong bla ma khyod kyis legs bsten pa'i | | gnas mchog dam pa dge legs dpal gyi mtshan/ /yid 'ong sna tshogs bkod pas lhang nge ba/ /thog mar de yi rang bzhin bsngags par bgyi/ /ji ltar nam mkha' kun la khyab mod kyang*/ /sprin bar khang pa'i mthongs na snang ba dang | | nyi ma nam mkha'i lam la rab rgyu yang*/ /shar gyi ri rtser 'char bar snang ba bzhin/ /'jam dbyangs chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa yi/ /zhing khams kun na bzhugs mod de lta na'ang*/ /thugs rje'i shugs dang gdul bya'i mos pa yis | | yul dus so sor snang bar gyur ba lags/ /de slad khyod kyi dag pa'i smon lam dag(《

lu 》 dang*/ ) /skal ldan rnams kyi bsod nams las grub pa'i/ / lhun po'i rgyal po'i ri bo rtse lnga ni/ /rtsa ba gser gyi dbang chen lta bu brtan/ /rtse mo bkod legs yongs su bskor ba'i tshul/ /dbus kyi ri bo seng ge bsgy-ings pa bzhin/ /brag ri kun+da'i mdangs ltar rab tu dkar/ /shar ri'i rtse mo glang po'i gtsug 'dra ba/ /rtswa mchog kha dog nam mkha'i mdangs ltar sngo/ /lho yi ri bo rta mchog nyal ba bzhin/ /me tog gser mdog ldan pas rnam par bkram/ / nub ri rma bya gar byed lta bu'i tshul/ /sa gzhi pad+ma rā ga'i 'od chags 'bar/ / byang ri mkha' lding 'dab gshog brkyang 'dra ba/ /margad mdog mtshungs ljon pas yongs su gang*/ /de slad 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i pho brang lags par khums/ /de 'dra'i lhun po 'phang dang rgyar yangs pa/ /sna tshogs shing dang lcug ma'i nags tshal bkram/ kha dog sna tshogs mdangs gsal me tog gi /tshom bu bkod legs ji bzhin rnam par bkra/ / 'du ba'i nad sel 'dus (《 zha 》《 lu 》 nus ) pa mchog ldan pa'i/ /rtsa ba lo ma me tog 'bras bu sogs/ /sman gyi tshogs kyis ngos rnams yongs su gang*/ /brag ri ri bo rin chen brtsegs 'dra dang*/ /dbang po'i gzhu ltar snang ba'i 'od 'byin pa'i/ /nor bu rdo yi snying pos rnam par spras/ kha dog dri ro nus pa phun tshogs pa'i/ /bza' dang bca' dang myang dang bldags pa dang*/ /ma rmos lo tog la sogs du ma dang*/ /mu tig chun po rnam par 'thor 'dra ba'i/ /gzegs ma gnam du 'phro ba'i rba 'khrugs pa'i/ /dri za'i bu mo'i dbyangs ltar snyan pa'i sgra | | kun tu sgrogs byed 'bab chu sna tshogs dang*/ /dri med dngul gyi me long bkod 'dra ba'i/ /lteng ka rdzing bu mtsho phran bkod ma rnams/ /yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chu yi gter/ /snying po rab rgyas ze'u 'bru'i phreng ldan zhing*/ /lo 'dab mdangs bkra las 'phros dri bsung gis/

/nye bar bsdus pa'i bung ba sgra 'byin pa'-i+i/ /pad+mo'i 'byung gnas dam pas nye bar bsten/ /ngang pa ngur pa khu byug la sogs pa/ /yid 'ong gzugs kyi dpal ldan na chung bzhin/ /dbyibs dang mdangs kyi sgeg chags las byung ba'i/ /glu dbyangs snyan pa kun tu sgrogs par byed/ /rlung ngad (《 lu 》 dang ) dal bus g.yo ba'i sil snyan sgras/ /nye bar bskul bas ljon shing ku sha'i tshogs/ /kun tu bskyod pa'i gar stabs legs byed cing*/ /ri dwags tshogs rnams rtse zhing dga' bar rol/ /gcan gzan lus rgyas rab tu dregs pa'i tshogs/ /bslab pas bsdams pa ji bzhin dul bar gnas/ /gdung ba skyob pa'i chu 'dzin bla rer bris/ /dri bsung gis bsgos ser bu'i bsil yab ldan/ /mi min gyis mchod mtshan mo sgron ma 'bar/ / 'dod chags bral ba 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams dang*/ /sa bla'i lha dang grub pa rig 'dzin dang*/ /dka' thub mthar phyin dmod pa'i mtshon 'chang ba'i/ /lha dang mi yi drang srong tshogs rnams dang*/ /klu dang gnod sbyin ma mo 'byung po sogs | | mthu stobs che ba che bar rab grags pa/ /rdzu 'phrul shugs 'chang bstan la mngon dga' bas/ /rtag par rgyun du bstan cing rim gror byed/ /klu yi bu rnams rang gi lus bstan nas/ /mi rnams kun dang rtsai zhing rnam par rol

| | de lta'i legs tshogs du mas brgyan pa'i gnas/ /lhun po 'di ni lhar bcas 'jig rten gyi/ /bsti gnas dam pa dge legs kun 'byung ba'i/ / mchod rten chen po de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phun sun tshogs pa'i gnas der rnam rol pa'i/ /'jam mgon de ni rgyal ba ji snyed kyis/ /legs par bsags pa'i bsod nams ye shes tshogs/ /de snyed legs grub khyod la phyag 'tshal lo | | gang gi rang bzhin thog ma med pa nas/ /shin tu rnam dag srid dang zhi ba'i bdag /ming dang mtshan ma kun gyis ma spros pa/ /mnyam nyid 'jam pa'i ngang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos kyi sprin la gnas pa rgya mtsho'i sprin/ /chos kyi tshim mdzad chos rje bde chen gter/ /thabs dang shes rab mnyam sbyor nges pa nyid | | 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /smon lam grub pa dmigs med thugs rje yis/ /gdul bya ji snyed de snyed rnam 'phrul zhing*/ / srid pa ji srid de srid mi 'gag pa/ /'jam dpal rnam par rol la phyag 'tshal lo | | sku med ma lags bems po ma lags shing*/ /mi gtsang rdzas las grub pa'i lus ma lags/ /dbang po'i gzhu ltar gsal bar ston mdzad pa/ /dri med sku 'chang khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lhun po lta bur rab tu brjid pa'i sku/ / mtshan dang dpe byad rgyan gyis rnam par spras/ /nyi ma stong las lhag pa'i 'od 'gyed pa/ /dpag yas 'jam pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji ltar nor bu chu shel dwangs pa ni/ /sna tshogs tshon gyi rkyen gyis du mar snang*/ /de bzhin bcom ldan gdul bya'i dbang gis na/ /rnam pa du mar ston la phyag 'tshal lo | | nyid kyi mdangs dang zhal dang phyag dang zhabs/ /nyams dang cha lugs rgyan dang phyag mtshan gdan/ /mos pa tha dad 'gro ba kun 'dul zhing*/ /zab mo'i don mtshon khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdul bya'i khams dang mos pa ji snyed pa | | de snyed mgon po khyod kyi gsung gi dbyangs/ /yan lag drug cus brgyan pa mtha' yas pa/

/dam chos sgrogs pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag med ston pa seng ge'i sgra bsgrags pas/ /mu stegs ri dwags gom pa 'khyor zhing 'bros// bdud sde'i wa tshogs snying rab 'gems byed pa/ /rgol ba tshar gcod gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyod gsung rig sngags sbyar bas zhi ba dang*/ /blo gros rgyas byed tshangs pa'i bu mo sogs/ /nye bar 'gugs byed drag po'i gsang sngags kyis | | bgegs kun 'joms par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyon mongs zug rngu'i tshogs rnams legs byang zhing*/ /las kyi 'ching grol skye ba'i gzeb las thar | | shes bya'i sgrib pa'i rab rib rnam dag pa/ /yang dag mthar son khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes bya'i gzugs brnyan ji bzhin sgrib med snang*/ /rten 'brel ma 'dres gzigs shing mnyam par dgongs/ /gzhan gyi don kun legs grub rtag par yang*/ /rtog pas mi bsgul thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / byams pa'i dkyil 'khor rgya chen yangs pa can/ /thugs rje chen pos sems can kun skyob cing*/ /'phags mchog rnams kyi yul las rnam 'das pa/ / 'jam dpal ye shes thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang bzhin dri med 'khor ba'i chos kyi gos/ /thabs kyi bdud bcas lam gyi rtsis bsgyur bas/ /grol ba'i yon tan sna tshogs tshon bkra ba/ /gnas yongs gyur pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo | | rang gzhan don gnyis rten dang brten pa dang*/ /thun mong ba dang phul du byung ba dang*/ /zab dang rgya che'i yon tan rin chen gyis/ /rab tu brgyan pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi zad tshig gi gter brnyes rgyal bas kyang*/ /blo mchog khyod kyi yon tan rgya mtsho'i gtos/ /bskal pa bye bar brjod kyang rdzogs bral ba | | yon tan mi zad gter la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji ltar yid bzhin nor bu rtog med par/ /skyes bu'i re ba yongs su rdzogs byed ltar/ /gsol ba btab na dgos 'dod kun 'byung ba/ /dbang gi rgyal po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/

/ mtha' yas gdul bya'i tshogs rnams re re la'ang/ /bgrang yas rnam par 'phrul pas don mdzad cing*/ /'khor ba'i 'khor lo ji srid phrin las kyi/ / 'khor lo rgyun mi 'chad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal sras rgya mtshos bskor ba'i rgyal ba yis/ /yongs su bstan pa'i zhing khams rgya mtsho yang*/ /ba spu'i bu gar 'phel 'grib rnam spangs nas/ /snang bar mdzad pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / sa yi rgya khyon zhabs kyi mthil gyis gnon/ /phyag gis nam mkha'i ngos kun yongs su khebs/ /'od kyis nyi ma bye ba rmugs byed pa/ /rnam 'phrul mtha' yas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bzhad pa'i dbyangs kyis sa gsum g.yo byed cing | | ha ha zhes byas rgya mtsho'i klong rnams skems/ /hūm̐ gis dus mtha'i me dpung 'jil byed pa/ /mdzad pa dpag yas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gaṅgā'i rdul snyed phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yis/ /bskal par mdzad pa phrin las rgya mtsho'i tshogs | | de snyed skad cig gcig gis rdzogs mdzad pa/ /phrin las ∶lhun grub (《 lu 》 grub pa ) khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gti mug gis non 'gro ba bskyab pa'i phyir/ /dbus kyi ri rtser me long ye shes bdag /'khor lo'i rigs kyi bdag po'i skur ston pa/ /gzugs phung sbyong mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhe sdang gis gzir 'gro ba bskyab pa'i phyir/ /shar gyi ri rtser chos dbyings ye shes bdag /rdo rje'i rigs kyi bdag po'i skur ston pa/ /rnam shes sbyong mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ser snas bcings pa'i 'gro ba bskyab pa'i phyir/ /lho yi ri rtser mnyam nyid ye shes bdag /rin chen rigs kyi bdag po skur ston pa | | tshor ba sbyaung mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dod chags kyis gzir 'gro ba bskyab pa'i phyir/ /nub kyi ri rtser kun rtog ye shes bdag /pad+ma'i rigs kyi bdag po'i skur ston pa/ /'du shes sbyaung mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phrag dog gis non 'gro ba bskyab pa'i phyir/

/byang gi ri rtser bya grub ye shes bdag | las kyi rigs kyi bdag po'i sku ston pa/ /'du byed sbyong mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po phal cher gdul bya dag pa la/ /seng ge'i gdan la bzhugs pa byu ru'i mdangs/ /yid bzhin shing rnams sna tshogs 'khor rnams kyis | | yongs su bskor bar ston la phyag 'tshal lo/ /la la la ni byis pa gzhon nu'i gzugs/ /rnam par rtse ba'i tshul gyis ston mdzad cing*/ /la lar dge sbyong drang srong rgan po sogs/ /sna tshogs skur ston khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyod kyi ngo mtshar dpag yas rgya mtsho las/ /thigs pa tsam zhig brjod 'di rgyal ba yi/ /lung dang rtogs pa brjod pa'i rjes 'brangs nas/ /rigs pa yis kyang dpyad de bsgrags pa las/ /sngon chad mig gi dbang pos ma mthong zhing*/ /ji bzhin rna bas kyang ni ma thos pa'i/ khyod kyi 'od zer shin tu phul byung ba/ / bdag gis mthong de mthong ba ji bzhin du/ /brjod par nus min ting 'dzin ro myang bzhin/ /'on kyang dran pa yis kyang dpal 'gyur bas/ /cha tsam tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis ni/ /nye bar sgrogs la mngon par sprau bar gyur/ khyod kyi 'od kyis zhing brgya snang byed cing*/ /log blo'i ku mud tshal 'joms rtag par yang | | blo gros pad+mo rab tu rgyas byed pa/ /ye shes nyi ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyod kyi 'od zer skye rgu'i yid 'phrog pa'i/ /thad na nyi ma'i 'od zer 'bar ba yang | | nyin mo'i zla ba tsam du'ang mi bzod na/ /mdzes pa gzhan kun zil gnon smos ci 'tshal/ /'od zer de yis nyon mongs gdung sel ba/ /bsil zer bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dra 'phro ba yis/ /ston zla rgyas pas dper yang mi bzod na | | log dang rab rib 'phrog pa smos ci 'tshal/ /de yis gdul bya'i zhing la dge legs kyi/ /lo tog rab tu bskrun pas rnam kun tu/ /char sprin rab tu sgrogs pa'ang zil gnon na/ /dad pa'i chu klung 'phel bgyid smos ci 'tshal/

/ mkha' dang sa dang bar snang thams cad du/ /gnas ma nges par 'od zer kun tu snang | kha dog sna tshogs mdangs chags rab tu gsal/ /dbyings ni rnam pa du mar ston par byed/ /na bun 'od zer phung por gyur pa 'ga'(《 zha 》 lags ) / / rlung gis bskyod pa'i rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs bzhin/ /zad mi shes pa bar snang mtshams na rgyu/ /'od zer la la spel legs me tog gi /phreng ba ji bzhin phan tshun brkyang ba dang*/ /la la nor bu spungs pa lta bu dang*/ /zla tshes 'dra dang tshes brgyad zla ba'i dbyibs/ /ka ba'i rnam pa lta bur snang ba dang*/ /'od zer chen po 'ga' zhig nam mkha' dang*/ /sa gzhi bar kun khyab par snang bas na/ /de mtha' tshad gzung bdag gis rngo ma thogs/ /margad pad+ma rā ga lta bu'i mdangs// 'dres pa'i 'od kyi gong bu rab zlum pa/ /sprin med nam mkha'i dkyil na snang ba ni | khyod kyi mdzod spu'i 'od ces rgyal rnams sgrogs/ /sa gzhi'i gtos kun rab dkar 'od kyis ni/ /snyoms par khebs pa 'o ma'i rgya mtsho bzhin/ /bar snang gser mdog 'od kyis gang ba dang*/ /res 'ga' pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs 'drar 'gyur/ /na bun nang na kha dog lngas bskor ba'i/ /'od 'khor 'khor lo lta bur snang ba ni/ /chu skyes chu gter dbus na rgyas pa bzhin/ /de mtha' rgyang nas 'od zer dkar pos bskor/ /de yi dbus na gzugs brnyan tshul gyis ni | | nyid sku dang ldan dag gis gsal bar dmigs/ /grangs ni nyi ma gcig la'ang brgya phrag snyed/ /bdag cag rnams kyis legs mthong res 'ga' ni/(《 lu 》 zhig ) /snang dang mi snang gnas skabs du mar snang*/ /'od kyi ser bu de 'dra gdul bya'i yid/ /bag chags chu gter 'dus pas brtan pa yang*/ /rab tu bskyod pas bsngags pa'i sgra sgrogs shing*/ /spy-i bos 'dud pa'i rba rlabs g.yo bar 'gyur/ /de ltar rgyal dang rgyal sras thams cad kyi/ /'od kyi mdzad pas zhing kun sbyong ba dang*/ /sems can smin par mdzad ces legs gsungs

pas | | 'jam dbyangs 'od la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /skya rengs 'od kyis skar ma zil gnon pa/ /gang gis mthong des nyi ma'i gzi brjid 'tshal/ /de bzhin 'od zer rmad byung mthong ba des/ /'od mdzad yon tan dpag yas lags par khums/ /de ltar 'jam dbyangs yon tan rgya mtsho mchog /dam chos rin chen mi zad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /'phags pa'i klu dbang tshogs kyis bsten pa la/ /srid pa kun tu nye bar skyabs su mchi/ /mgon po'i zla zhal dri med legs mthong zhing*/ /srid pa'i zug rngu rnam par sel ba yi/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i bsil zer rab 'phro ba/ /rna ba'i snod du 'bab par mdzad du gsol | | kun bzang rnam 'phrul mchod rdzas rgya mtsho'i sprin/ /kun nas bkod legs yid 'ong bkram pa yis/ /kun tu nam mkha' khyab par blos sprul te/ / kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs 'khor bcas rtag tu mchod/ /tshul dang tshul min bdag gis ma 'tshal zhing*/ /las dang nyon mongs tshang tshing gis gzings pas// lus dang ngag dang yid kyis bsags pa'i sdig /rgyal dang rgyal sras rnams kyi spyan sngar bshags/ /dus gsum phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad na/ / khams gsum gtogs pa'i skye bo ma lus dang*/ /lam gsum mthar phyin 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams kyi/ /sgo gsum dge ba kun la rjes yi rangs/ / srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam par gzhig pa'i phyir/ /theg mchog chos kyi 'khor lo bskor slad du/ /'jam dbyangs rgyal ba'i 'khor gyis yongs bskor ba'i/ / dkyil 'khor kun tu bzhugs te bskul bar bgyi/ /nyid kyi nges pa'i sku ni rtag bzhugs kyang*/ /ma nges gdul bya bsod nams mi ldan pas/ /nges pa'i dbyings su zhi bar mthong rnams la/ /nges par rtag tu khyod sku snang bar mdzod// 'gro kun rnam grol mchog la dgod bya'-i phyir/ /blau mchog 'jam mgon rjes su bdag zhugs nas/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing*/ /byang chub spyod mchog rgya chen spyad par bgyi/

/yon tan rgya mtsho mgon po 'jam dbyangs la | | bstod dbyangs rgya mtshos gus pas mchod pa dang*/ /kun mkhyen rgya mtsho'i spyod pa legs spyad pas/ /dge ba rgya mtsho bdag gis gang bskrun dang*/ /dus rnams rgya mtshor skye bo thams cad dang*/ /'phags pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi legs bsags pa'i/ /bsod nams rgya mtsho'i ji snyed yod pa kun/ /lhag bsam rgya mtsho gcig tu bsdoms byas nas/ /sems can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams ji snyed kyi | | sdug bsngal rgya mtsho rnam par byang gyur nas/ /tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho rdzogs nas rgyal ba yi/ /ye shes rgya mtsho myur du 'jug gyur cig /bdag kyang deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /rigs gzugs dpal 'byor dbang phyug phun tshogs shing*/ /tshe ring nad med blo gros mchog gyur nas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bstan pa 'dzin gyur cig /bdud kyi stobs dang mu stegs gzhung lugs dang | | chos ltar bcos pa'i mun sprul thams cad dang*/ /gzhan yang 'gro ba'i nye bar 'tshe ba kun/ /bdag gi stobs kyis rtsad nas 'joms gyur cig /skye rgu rnams kyi srid pa'i bde legs dang*/ /rnam par grol ba'i dpal 'byor gang yin pa/ /de kun 'bad pa med par bdag las ni/ /rang dbang nyid du ci bder 'byung gyur cig /'jam pa'i dpal gyi rnam 'phrul ji snyed pa/ /de snyed skad cig re la'ang bdag gis ni/ /ba spu'i bu ga re rer sprul nas kyang*/ /nam mkha'i mthas gtugs 'gro ba'i don byed shog /gnas skabs su yang bstan la gang dga' zhing*/ /sems can rnams la byams pa'i blo dang ldan/ /de 'dra'i mi dbang rtag tu zhabs brtan zhing*/ /de yi bsam pa chos bzhin 'grub par shog | 'gro kun phan tshun brtse ba'i yid ldan zhing*/ /chos dang zang zing dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs/ /e ma ngo mtshar zhes brjod gad mo'i sgras/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi bsam pa tshim gyur cig /de ltar brjod 'di gang gi mthus byung ba

| | shes bya kun mkhyen dmigs med thugs rje can/ /chos kyi rgyal po dpal ldan bzang po'i zhabs/ /'dren mchog de la slar yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /blo gros rgya mtsho'i gling las legs 'khrungs pa'i/ /snyan pa'i 'od 'phro tshig gi nor bu'i tshogs | | ngag gi srad bus tshar du dngar byas nas/ /'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal po legs mchod do/ /bstod tshig 'di ni nor bu'i phreng ba yin/ /'di yis gang gis mgrin par brgyan pa de'i/ /sems la 'jam pa'i rdo rje rjes zhugs nas | | bsnyengs bral blo gros mchog dang ldan par 'gyur/ /tshul 'di ni shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa'i de kho na nyid ston pa la/ bsnyengs pa mi mnga' ba'i mkhyen rab can/ 'gro ba thams cad la bu gcig pa ltar rab tu brtse ba'i thugs rje (《 zha 》《 lu 》 - rje ) mnga' ba sa'i steng na 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba'i bdag nyid chen po/ chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i zhabs kyi rdul gyis spyi gtsug brgyan cing legs par bshad pa rin po che'i tshogs kyis blo gros kyi lus rnam par brgyan pa/ 'phags pa'i ming dang ldan pas ri bo rtse lnga de nyid du me mo sbrul gyi lo zla ba bdun pa'i tshes nyi shu gcig la rdzogs par sbyar ba'o

|| || ༄༅/ /phyag mtshan ri mo'i bstod tshig spel ba bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde gshegs thub pas sa gsum snyan par bsgrags/ /'gro ba'i sgron ma dkon mchog rin chen gter/ /mkhas pa 'dus pa'i tshogs su gsal mdzad pa/ /'jam mgon bla ma'i zhabs la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /mi shes rab rib tshogs pa'i blo mig can/ /log lta'i drwa ba stong gis dkrigs pa'i sa/ /kla klo 'dus pa gangs ri'i khrod 'dir sngon/ /ring zhig lon nas thub pa'i bstan pa gsal/ /rgyal ba'i sras po thugs rje'i blo gros can/ /spyod pa dag pa smon lam legs sbyangs pa/ /phrin las grub pa brtson pa'i brtul zhugs can | | lha dbang tshogs kyi dpag bsam shing 'dra ba/ /gang la 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rjes bzung ba'i/ /chos kyi rgyal po sa chen skyong ba po/ /rnam dpyod blo can des pas 'gro ba 'dul/ khyod kyi phrin las bsam yas lhun gyis grub | | mi yi bdag po chos bzhin sa skyong ba/ /dgongs pa dag pa dge ba'i ngang tshul can/ /dpa' mdzangs blon po'i tshogs kyis yongs bskor te/ /skye rgu 'di dag bu bzhin legs par bskyangs/ /sdom brtson dam pa dpal ldan zhi ba 'tsho | | brtul zhugs grub pa pad+ma 'byung gnas dpal/ /blo gsal dbang po pad+ma'i ngang tshul sogs/ /snyigs ma'i dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa yin/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i ring lugs bla na med/ /zhu chen sgyur byed mchan bu'i gnas 'dug pa'i/ /skad gnyis smra ba'i 'gro ba'i mig gyur pas/ /don sgra ji bzhin legs par bsgyur ba yi/ /bshad pas thub pa'i bstan pa gsal bar mdzad/ / de lta'i rnam thar mchog tu rmad byung ba/ /sa steng rgyas par kun tu rab grags pa' | | sgo gsum g.yo ba med pa'i phrin las can/ /ma smad che ba'i bdag can de dag la/ /kun+da'i phreng 'dra so yi ze 'bru can/ /pad ltar yangs pa'i mig gi 'dab rgyas pa/

/snyan dngags sbrang rtsi'i dri ngad phyogs bcur khyab/ /dpal ldan me tog rgyas pa'i tshig mkhan gyi/ /tshig bzang me tog sil ma rab bkod pa/ / sdeb sbyor mdud pas tshom bur legs bsdoms te/ /yi ge'i rgyan gyi thor cog yid 'phrog pa/ /snyan dngags dbyibs mdzes chun por rab spel nas/ /'di 'dra'i bstod bzang me tog phreng rgyun gyis/ /'gro ba'i sgrol ma shin tu brgyan bya'i phyir/ /rgyun mkhan ngal ba 'bras bu dang bcas pa/ /'di la spyan ras gzigs pa dpal yon can/ /phun sum tshogs 'dzin bden pa'i sprin ldan 'gro mgon mchog tu zhi ba bsam yas phrin las can/ /gang zhig lha dang lha min klu dbang dri za'i gtso bos kun nas dga' bas legs mchod pa/ /thub pa ser skya grog mkhar ba dang rkang mig gis sbyar blo yi rab rib kun sel ba'i// bde bar gshegs pa'i sgron ma sa gsum gsal mdzad sngon med nyi ma de la bdag dad do/ /bdag kyang sngon sbyangs las kyi 'phen pa yis/ /snyigs ma'i dus su gangs ri'i khrod 'dir skyes/ /'on kyang tshe rabs snga ma'i bsod nams mthus | | shes bya phal cher 'bad pa chung ngus shes/ /rtsod dus 'di na mkhas par khas 'che zhing*/ /lan brgyar 'chad dang nyan par mngon brtson pa/ /de dag gis kyang shes bya'i gnas rnams la/ /rnam par dpyad na phyogs re'i mig can yin/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi phyag mtshan gyi ri mo 'di/ gtsug lag khang 'di la phan pa'i rten 'brel zhig yod pas dpal ldan sa skya pas bris pa yin | cung zad ri mo ma mdzes kyang mtshan mor bris pa dang*/ pir la sogs pa ma 'dzoms pas lan pa lags/ 'on kyang bkra shis pa'i rten 'brel zhig yod pas | sus kyang mi bsub par zhu/ /sgra dang tshad ma'i mig gnyis dang ldan pas | | shes bya'i dkyil 'khor lta ba'i blo gros can/ /mang du thos shing legs par sbyong ba po/ /skad gnyis smra ba dpal ldan sa skya pas/ /nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can rnams/

/kun mkhyen rgyal po'i go 'phang thob phyir dang | | 'gro ba'i bla ma de dag mnyes bya'i phyir/ /dam chos dkon mchog sgron ma gsal bar bshad// //'gro ba'i bla ma yon tan rin chen gter/ /phyogs rnams kun tu snyan pa'i dris khyab pa'i/ /bstan pa 'jig rten khams 'dir gsal bya'i phyir/ /sde snod 'dzin pa dpal ldan sa skya pas/ /bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas chen 'dir/ /zab cing rgya che'i chos rnams bshad pa las/ /byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gang yod des/ /'gro ba srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog /ri bong 'dzin pa bsil ba'i 'od zer can/ /mtshan mo sa dang nam mkha'i gsal byed dang | | log blo'i rgyu skar tshogs rnams zil mnan nas/ /me tog kun+da'i tshogs rnams kha 'byed byed/ /tshigs su bcad pa 'di rnams bla ma chos kyi rje dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen pos/ dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen por/ mkhas pa rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu slob dpon bdag nyid chen po ka ma la shī la'i chos kyi gdan seng ge'i khri bshams pa ga la ba der bzhugs nas | zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing*/ bstan pa rin po che'i byi dor dang skye rgu'i tshogs rab tu mang po'i don mdzad pas/ nyid kyi thugs cung zad rangs par yang gyur cing*/ sngon gyi dam pa de dag gi rnam par thar pa dang*/ rmad du byung ba'i phrin las rjes su dgongs shing*/ mngon sum du gzigs la dus kyi 'gyur bas skye rgu'i tshogs ma rungs par gyur pa mkhyen pa'i dbang gis thugs cung zad gdung bar yang gyur nas/ slad nas 'jig rten chos kyis bde legs su gyur cig snyam du dgongs te/ gtsug lag khang gi 'khor sa'i ngos ji ltar rigs pa'i gzhi dag la nyid kyi phyag g.yas pa'i rin po che mngon par brkyang nas yi ge'i 'du bya ba mngon par 'du mdzad pa las/ phyag rgya'i dbyibs las ri mo'i gzugs brnyan gyi tshul gyis brgyud de/

bdag gi sug tu babs pa rnams phyogs gcig tu nye bar bsgrigs pa 'di gang gis mthong ba dang*/ kha ton du byed pa de'i rgyud la mdzad pa po'i ye shes gzigs pa'i dam pa 'jug par gyur cig ces dge slong 'phags pas smras so// // ༄༅/ /'jam dpal brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i bstod pa bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhṃ/ na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes las grub pas/ /yi ge mum̐ las rnam par skyed pa po/ /thugs rje chen pos srid par ∶bzhugs pas na(《 zha 》 rab zhugs nas ) / /sna tshogs pad+mo rgyas pa'i gdan dang ni/ /yang dag shes pas zhi la gnas pa'i phyir/ /bsil zer byed pa'i dbus na brjid par bzhugs/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med mnyam sbyor bas | | gzhon nu'i zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil mo krung*/ /bden gnyis don mtshon mgon po'i phyag gnyis kyis/ /mthu stobs brnyes slad ral gri 'debs pa'i tshul | | brtse chen srid pa'i nyes pas ma gos shing*/ /shes bya ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen pa'i phyir/ /ut+pal mthon mthing ze'u 'bru'i phreng ba can/ /glegs bam dang bcas rtag tu legs par bsnams/ /bsod nams ye shes dpal gyi tshogs rdzogs pas/ /mtshan dpes rab mdzes gser bzang 'bar ba'i mdangs | | phul byung yon tan du ma'i gter gyur slad/ /rin chen gyis spras dar gyi na bzas klubs/ /gdod nas dag cing nye bar zhi bas na/ /zla ba nya ltar shin tu des pa'i tshul/ /dbyings dang ye shes kun tu ro gcig pas/ /spyi gtsug mi 'khrugs rgyal ba'i dbang pos brgyan/ /bde chen rol pas mgon po 'gying ba'i sku/ /dus kyi dgrar gyur ral pa añdza'i mdog /rga sha'i 'jigs spangs gzhon nur gyur pa ste/ /gzhan don dgyes pas 'dzum pa'i zhal ras can | | sna tshogs sprul mdzad 'od zer mtha' yas pa/ /bcom ldan 'jam pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyod gsung rig sngags sbyar ba'i yi ge oṃ/ /rgyal ba kun gyi sku yi sa bon te/

/yi ge lnga ni thub pa kun gyi gsung*/ /dam chos thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i sgo/ /mum̐ ni yid de bde gshegs thams cad kyi/ / gnyis med ye shes mtshon par byed pa'o/ /de slad bcom ldan khyod kyi gsang sngags 'di/ /gsang gsum mtshon byed rigs gsum skul byed cing*/ /chos rnams kun gyi snying por gyur pas na/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gsang sngags lags par khums/ /phul byung dngos grub nye bar 'gugs byed cing*/ /yid skyob byed pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyod kyi thugs ka'i shes rab 'khor lo ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs kyi rang bzhin te/ /'khor lo'i rten gyur zla ba rgyas pa yis | | 'jig rten pa dang thun mong ye shes mtshon/ /gang gi ye shes zer gyis skye bo yi/ /bdag 'dzin gcod phyir 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa/ /nyon mongs gnas gyur ye shes lnga rnams dang*/ /rang bzhin skye med rdul bral dam pa'i don | | 'chi 'pho med cing ming dang bral ba'i tshul/ /nye bar ston phyir a ra pa tsa na | | spros med don las rnam par spros pa dang*/ /tshad med pa dang mi 'jigs mtshon pa'i phyir/ /ni pra pañtsa'i yi ge rnam pa bzhi/ /ming tshig yi ge'i tshogs la dbang 'byor zhing*/ /thabs dang shes rab las 'khrungs dbyangs dang ni | | gsal byed yi ges brgyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /blo mchog bcom ldan mgon po 'jam dbyangs kyi/ /sku dang gsang sngags shes rab 'khor lo rnams// rgyal ba kun gyi sku gsung thugs nyid du/ /bstod pa 'di ni dpal ldan 'phags pas bgyis/ /de las dge ba gang zhig ston zla ltar/ /dri med nam mkha'i ngos ltar yangs pa gang*/ /nye bar bsags des nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i/ / lus can thams cad 'jam dbyangs nyid gyur cig /'phags pa 'jam dpal brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i bstod pa/ lung rigs kyi de kho na nyid smra ba'i btsun pa 'phags pas sbyar ba'o// //༄༅/ /ri bo rtse lnga so so'i rigs su mthun pa'i bstod pa bzhugs/

/ ༄༅/ /na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ byams pa'i lte ba rab tu brtan zhing mthu stobs rno ba'i rtsibs stong ldan/ /phan bde'i mu khyud rgya chen gyis bskor smon lam shugs kyis legs rgyu zhing*/ /bdag tu lta ba'i ri bo rab bsnyil phas rgol dpung gi tshogs 'joms pa/ /'jam dpal 'khor lor grags pa'i mtshan can skyob pa mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan gang thugs gnyis med ye shes sna tshogs rtog pas mi phyed cing*/ /mkhyen pa'i me 'od 'bar ba'i zer 'phro srid pa'i ri bo rab 'jig cing*/ /bdud kyi grong khyer rnam par 'joms byed lta ngan gyis ltar mi bzod pa/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i lha dbang gis 'dzin 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i zhabs la 'dud/ /srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' gnyis rnam spangs rgyal ba'i ye shes rgya mtshor 'khrungs/ /thugs rje'i dbyibs mdzes yon tan mdog bzang bsdu dngos bzhi yi 'od 'byin cing*/ /blo gsal klu dbang gtsug gi rgyan gyur gdul bya'i dgos 'dod kun 'byung ba/ /blo mchog 'jam dpal yid bzhin nor bu gus pa'i gtsug gis rtag tu mchod/ /dge tshogs dpag med chu gter dbus su byang sems sa bon las 'khrungs shing*/ /byang chub phyogs chos lo 'dab rab rdzogs dbang bcu'i ze 'brus yongs bskor ba'i/ /ting 'dzin snying po bde chen bcud ldan gzungs dang spaubs pa'i mdangs rab gsal/ / 'phags pa'i tshogs kyi bung bas legs bsten 'jam dbyangs pad+mo la phyag 'tshal | | bsod nams mtha' yas lcags kyi khams las thabs mkhas skyes bus legs bsgrubs pa'i/ /ye shes ral gri sprul pa'i 'od 'phro phrin las thogs med rab rno zhing*/ /gdul bya'i srid sde rab tu snyems byed nag po'i rtsa lag dpung 'joms pa/ /sdug bsngal myu gu rnam par gcod byed rdo rje rnon po la phyag 'tshal/ /me mo sbrul gyi lo dbyar zla 'bring po'i yar gyi ngo la rim gyis ri bo rtse lnga'i rtse mo rnams su phyag 'tshal du phyin pa'i tshe ri bo'i rtse mo so so'i rigs su mthun par bstod pa 'di'ang 'phags pas sbyar ba'o//

//༄༅/ /ā nan+da kīrti'i don du dpa' bo'i 'khor lo bris pa bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /pañtsa parba ta bi kri ḍa mañdzu gho ṣā pā da stu bh+yaṃ/ shar lho nub byang dbus kyi ri rtser ni/ siṃ ha ma ga ga las rnam skyes pa/ /siṃ ha ha ya ma yū ri dang yang | | ga ru ḍa dang ga dza'i gdan steng du/ /a ra pa tsa na las 'khrungs pa ya | | rgyal ba rnam lnga zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /so so'i mdangs gsal phyag g.yas ral gri 'dzin/ /g.yon pa ut+pal pusti bcas pa 'chang*/ /ral pa'i khrod las rdo rje sems dpa' dpal/ /dar dang me tog rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ / 'od zer dra bas zhing kun khyab mdzad par/ /rang yang mdun du dmigs par byas nas des/ /de la gtad de dang po yi ge oṃ/ /a ra pa tsa na dang tha mar dhīḥ | rtag tu zlos pas blo gros rgya che zhing*/ /thogs med myur ba'i spobs pa mchog ldan 'gyur/ /a ni ā dar+sha dz+nyā na'o/ /ra ni rat+na saṃ bha wa'o/ /pa ni pā da kū la ba tī'o/ /tsa ni tsa lan+ti karma'o/ /na ni nā ma rū pa shūn+ya tād+ma ka'o/ /yi ge'i don to/ /lung dang mi 'gal bar bsams par zad kyi/ 'di nyid ji lta ba bzhin du bshad pa ni ma mthong mod/ 'di la nan tan byas na byin rlabs ni nges par 'byung ngo*/ /mi th+ya bi ru dha sho k+ṣa ma ka ra/ ār+yas ā nan+da kīrti'i don du dpa' bo'i 'khor lo nyid bris pa'o// //༄༅/ /yang 'jam dbyangs la bstod pa bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ rnam pa sna tshogs lo 'dab kyis bkra ze 'bru'i phreng ldan rtsa ba brtan zhing rab rgyas chu skyes lte ba la/ /mun pa mun nag tshang tshing rab sel chu shel las grub ches 'phro 'bar ba'i ri bong can gyi gdan steng du/ /kun tu mdzes pa'i sku mnga' gser sbyangs mdog mtshungs lang tsho rab rgyas rin chen gyis spras zur phud lnga dang ldan/ /mi shes shes mdzad shes rab ral gri ut+pa la bsnams rdzu 'phrul du mas rab rtsen 'jam dbyangs la phyag 'tshal

| | gang thugs rang bzhin nam mkha' bzhin du gdod nas rnam dag srid dang zhi la gnyis su med par rtag bzhugs kyang*/ /rnam 'phrul dpag med rin chen las grub sku yi dkyil 'khor smon lam rlung gis dag snang mkha' la legs rgyu zhing*/ /legs bshad gsung 'od rnam 'phrul du ma'i kha dog gis brgyan skad cig gcig la'ang phyogs phyogs kun tu rab bkye bas/ /mi shes mun sel shes rab pad+mo rnam par rgyas byed blo mchog 'jam dbyangs skye rgu'i sgron ma bdag skyabs mchi/ /sprin bral mkha' la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lhang der gnas ltar gang gi thugs/ /sgrib gnyis dang bral phyogs las rnam rgyal mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar ba'i sku/ /rnam pa sna tshogs sprul pa'i 'od kyis gdul bya'i yid 'phrog bcom ldan 'das/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas gzhon nu'i tshul 'chang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// //༄༅/ /skyid grong gi 'phags pa wa tī la mnal lam du bstod pa bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /na maḥshrī lo ke shwa rā ya/ 'phags pa 'jig rten mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi

| | thugs rje gcig tu bsdus pa'i dngos/ /de mtshan thugs rje che zhes bgyi// spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyid sku pad+ma rā ga mtshungs/ /brtse bas 'gro la rjes su chags/ /gcig tu gzhan gyi don brtson pa/ /spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang bzhin don gyi yon tan rdzogs/ /sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes/ /phrin las 'od zer stong 'bar ba/ /spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyod kyi gzhon nu'i sa brnyes shing*/ /'dod pa'i nyes pas ma gos phyir/ /lo brgyad byis pa'i tshul 'dzin pa/ /spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'i bstod pas(《 zha 》 pa ) / skyid grong gi 'phags pa wa tī la bstod pa/ bya lo zla ba bzhi pa'i nyi shu brgyad kyi nyin par gnyid log pa'i rmi lam du byung ngo*/ /lhag ma rnams ma dran no// //༄༅/ /byams pa la bstod pa bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ byams pa'i thugs kyis byang chub thugs bskyed nas | | byams brtse'i mkhyen pas tshogs gnyis rdzogs mdzad de/ /byams pas dga' ldan lha yi tshogs skyong ba/ /byams mgon rgyal ba'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo | | zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa mchog sbyin gyis/ /skye rgu rnams la mchog gi 'bras stsolazhing*/ /g.yon pas klu shing me tog legs bsnams pa/ / byams mgon rgyal ba'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ral pa'i thor tshugs mchod rten gyis mdzes shing*/ /ril ba spyi blugs las byung dag byed kyis/ /rul dang myags pa'i dri ma rnam sbyong ba/ /rol pa chen po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / mchod phyir thogs dang khri snyan sā le yi/ /lpags pa'i chos gos mchog gi rtags kyis ni/ /dka' thub mthar phyin par ni zhal bzhes pa/ /drang srong mchog la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor ba'i 'dam las nges par brgyal (《 lu 》 brgal 《 zha 》 - brgyal ) ba khyod/ /'dam skyes gdan la bzhengs nas zhi ba yi | | spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs pas zhi mdzad pa/

/skye rgu'i gnyen gcig khyod la skyabs su mchi/ khyod la 'dun pa'i yid kyis dbang bgyis nas/ khyod sku rin chen mchog las legs bzhengs pa'i/ /sku 'di khyod nyid lags par legs bsams nas/ /shin tu dang ba'i yid kyis gsol 'debs kyis/ /ye shes gzigs pa'i dam pas nyer gzigs la/ /thugs rje chen po'i thugs kyis rab dgongs te/ /phrin las rgya mtsho rgya mtsho ltar bsdus nas/ /nyid ji bzhin du byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /de ltar thugs dam brtan pas byin rlabs pa'i/ / sku 'di nyid gcig kho nar ma bas te/ /dbyings dang mdzad pa gcig phyir rgyal ba kun/ /gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo nyid lags grang*/ /de 'dra mthong ba'i mig de dpal ldan zhing*/ /de la 'dun pa'i 'dun pa dpal 'bras can/ /mchod pas mchod bya ji (《 zha 》 de ) bzhin mchod byed de/ /mchod 'os rnams kyi mchod byar 'gyur lags grang*/ /de las dge ba rgya mtsho gang bskrun pa/ /'di 'dra gang gi dpal las byung gyur pa'i/ /rgyal po dam pa gser mchog dpal dang bcas | | rgyu sbyor byed pa ston tshul zhes bya ba/ /de yis dmigs bya rdo rje chos skyong gis/ /nye bar bsrungs pa'i chos skyong srung ma rnams/ /tshe 'dir tshe ring nad med dpal 'byor rgyas/ /skye ba kun tu lha mi'i dpal rgyas la/ /dga' mgur spyad nas byams mgon chos kyi rje/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i rgyal thabs mdzad pa'i tshe/ /chos kyi rgyal srid yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /nye bar zhugs nas thub de sras dang bcas/ /mchod sprin rgya mtshos kun nas legs mchod de/ / chos tshul rgya mtsho thos shing legs rtogs nas/ /de yi ye shes gzigs pa nyer zhugs te/ /byang chub dam par lung bstan thob par shog /de skad smras te smra ba rnams kyi rje/ /chos rje sa skya pa zhes yongs grags pa'i/ /zhabs kyi pad+mo spyi bos gus blangs pa/ /dge slong 'phags pa zhes byar grags pa la/

/grub pa dpal zhes bya bas gsol btab nas/ /me pho byi ba'i dpyid zla 'bring po yi/ /nyi shu bdun la gru mur zhes bya bar/ /yud tsam nyid la nye bar sbyar ba yin// //༄༅/ /gnas brtan bcu drug la bstod pa bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /dgra bcom blo mchog dbang dul ba/ /bstan pa srid du brtan bzhugs nas/ /'dzin dang skyong dang srung mdzad pa/ /bcu drug bzhugs pa 'di lta ste/ /bha ra dhā dza bsod snyoms len/ /gser can ba ku la dang ni/ /lam bstan rdo rje mo yi bu/ /sbed byed sgra gcan 'dzin dang ni/ /klu sde gnas brtan yan lag 'byung*/ /nags na gnas dang ma pham pa/ /lam phran bstan dang gser phreng dang*/ /mi phyed pa dang dus ldan dang*/ /de bzhin bzang po zhes bya ba | | de dag rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// //༄༅/ /yan lag bdun pa bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /dus gsum phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten du/ /'gro ba'i don du byon gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang chos rnams dang*/ /dge 'dun rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun bzang mchod sprin lta bu yis/ /de dag thams cad mchod par bgyi | | bdag dang mtha' yas sems can kun/ /dkon mchog go 'phang thob bya'i phyir/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /bdag dang 'gro bas bgyis pa'i sdig /ma lus mngon du mthol bgyid nas/ /'gyod cing bsdam pa'i sems kyis su/ /thams cad so sor bshags par bgyi/ /dge ba kun la yi rang zhing*/ /bdag kyang de bzhin byed par smon/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad la/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /srid pa ji srid gnas kyi bar/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bdag gsol 'debs | | mgon med 'di dag bskyab pa'i phyir/ /mgon pos ji ltar thugs bskyed pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis sems bskyed cing*/ /de yi spyod pa'ang bslab par bgyi/ /dge ba 'di dang dge ba gzhan/ /ma lus gcig tu bsdoms byas nas | | rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog

/srid pa kun tu dal 'byor lus | | yon tan bdun ldan thob gyur nas/ /yang dag bla mas rjes gzung ste// rtag tu dam chos spyod par shog /'dir yang nad med bde ldan zhing*/ /bdud dang bar du gcod pa kun/ /thams cad mthun rkyen nyid gyur nas/ /bsam pa chos bzhin 'grub par shog /'di'i don rtag tu dran pa'i tshul gyis kha ton gyis | nges par gdon mi za bar bsod nams kyi tshogs 'phel ba dang*/ sdig pa zad par 'gyur ba yin no// //༄༅/ /phyag mchod sdig bshags bsngo ba dang bcas pa bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs/ /gcig tu bsdus pa dpal ldan chos kyi rje/ /gzhan gyi don du skye bo'i skur ston pa/ / mtshungs med bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rkang gnyis gtso bo thub dbang rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /zhi ba chags bral nges 'byin dam pa'i chos/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la/ /rtag tu gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos su 'byor dang bdag pos ma bzung ba/ /yid kyis sprul dang bla na med pa yi/ /mchod sprin rgya mtsho bkod ∶pa'i (《 zha 》 pa ) mtha' klas pas | | bla ma rnams dang dkon mchog mchod par bgyi/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyi/ /thog med dus nas nyon mongs dbang gyur pas | | lus ngag yid kyis sdig pa ci bgyis pa/ /bla ma rnams dang dkon mchog spyan sngar bshags/ /phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa yi/ / dge ba 'di dang dge ba ma lus gzhan/ /thams cad blo yis gcig tu bsdoms byas nas/ /sangs rgyas thob phyir yongs su bsngo bar bgyi/ /bla ma rnams dang dkon mchog rin chen dang*/ /chos skyong 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyi/ / bden pa'i mthu yis deng 'dir bde legs shog/ // ༄༅/ /sems bskyed kyi cho ga bsdus pa bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'o nyid cag byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga bzhed par gda' bas/

bdag gis sems bskyed pa'i cho ga bgyi/ de la 'o skol thams cad kyis skye ba snga ma la bsod nams bsags pa'i stobs kyis mi'i lus rin po che thob/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mjal/ de ltar gyur pa'i gnas skabs 'dir chos re ma byas/ lam sna re ma zin na tshe la nges pa med pas nam 'chi ∶mi shes(《 zha 》 cha med ) / skye ba la rang dbang ma thob pas gar skye mi shes/ cis kyang 'chi zhing skye ba bzang ngan gang len las dge sdig gi rjes su 'brang ba lags/ da ltar rang dbang yod pa'i skabs 'dir dkar po'i dge ba'i chos re bgyid 'tshal/ chos de'ang bstan pa 'di las phyi rol du gyur pa mu stegs dang*/ sog po la sogs pa'i lam de rnams ston pa 'khor ba las ma grol/ bstan pa nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por mi 'gyur bas/ lam gyi tshul de dag la 'bad pa bgyis kyang mtho ris kyi 'bras bu'ang thob par dka' na/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa thob pa smos ci 'tshal/ 'o na lam gang gis grol bar 'gyur na/ 'o skol gyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bdag nyid 'khor ba'i nyes pa las grol/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes mngon du mdzad/ nyid kyi ji ltar mngon du mdzad pa ltar/ gzhan dag la'ang bstan pas/ ston pa mya ngan las 'da' bar byed pa zhes bgyi ba lags/ de lta bu'i sangs rgyas des bstan pa'i chos spyir bsam gyis mi khyab na'ang | theg pa che chung gnyis su 'du ba lags par gda' bas/ theg pa chung ngu'i lam gyis rang nyid zhi bar byed tsam ma gtogs pa/ gzhan gyi don rgya chen po dang sangs rgyas thob pa'i gegs su 'gyur bas/ theg pa dman par gsungs pa lags/ theg pa chen po 'di bsam pa dang sbyor ba rgya chen pos rang dang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa 'grub par bgyid pas theg pa chen po'i lam 'di la nan tan du bgyid 'tshal/ theg pa chen po'i de'i gzhi dang lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa yin par gsungs/

de'ang dang por yang dag par blangs pa zhes bgyi ba dge ba'i bshes gnyen las len ∶dgos pa gda' na(《 zha 》 par brten ) / nyid cag phal cher gyis sems bskyed pa thob pa lags pas de rnams kyi bag chags gso zhing gsal 'debs pa dang*/ ma thob pa rnams kyis thob par bya ba'i don du/ de ring yang sems bskyed pa bgyid pas/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su bla ma dam pa brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa bzhugs par bsgom/ de rnams kyi spyan sngar bdag la sems bskyed pa gnang bar zhu zhes gsol ba 'debs par bsgoms la bdag gi lad mo mdzod cigarigs kyi bu bdag la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam skyabs gsum sngon du 'gro ba can gyi byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod do | | de ltar bgyid pa de khyed kyis bdag la gsol ba btab pa lags/ da bdag gis kyang sems bskyed pa'i cho ga bgyid pa lags/ de la sbyor ba dngos gzhi | rjes rnam pa gsum yod pa las/ thog mar sbyor ba'i cho ga la bdun yod pa'i ser sna'i las kyi sgrib pa dag par bya ba'i don du dkon mchog mchod pa bgyi | de la thog mar bkur sti'i mchod pa zhes bya ba phyag 'tshal ba lags pas | bdag gi lus dpag tu med par sprul la sems can thams cad dang thabs cig tu phyag 'tshal bar bsgoms la/ thal mo sbyor la bdag gi lad mo mdzod cig na mo bud+dha ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na mas+saṃ ghā ya/ na mas+sarba bud+dha bho dhi sa twa nāṃ/ man+t+ra de wa ta/ oṃ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ zhes lan gsum brjod/ de nas me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa thams cad lha rdzas las grub pa/ nam mkha'i khams khyab pas bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum mchod par bsgoms la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/

de bzhin du/ pād+yāṃ pra tīts+tsha/ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ badz+ra dhūp+pe/ badz+ra ā lo ke badz+ra gan+dhe/ badz+ra nai wi d+ye/ badz+ra shap+ta pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes (《 zha 》+ lan gcig ) brjod do | | de rnams mchod pa lags/ da log pa'i skyabs gnas la mos pa'i las kyi sgrib pa sbyang ba dang*/ rten khyad par can la brten pa'i don du skyabs su 'gro ba bgyid pas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis dus da nas bzung nas ji srid sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro bar bsgoms la/ bdag gi lad mo mdzod cig phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag dang sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung nas byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o | | 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ / tshogs rnams kyi mchog byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// de ltar skyabs su song bas skyabs khyad par can dang bcas shing*/ sdom pa thams cad kyi rten dang ldan par gyur pa lags/ da sngon bsags kyi sdig pa thams cad dag par bya ba'i don du sdig pa bshags par bgyid pa/ bla ma dang*/ dkon mchog gi spyan sngar bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis sngar byas pa'i sdig pa thams cad bshags/ phyin chad nus tshad kyis bsdam snyam du bsgoms la bdag gi lad mo mdzod cig phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis tshe thog ma med pa nas las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang du gyur pas/ lus dang*/ ngag dang*/ yid kyi sgo gsum nas/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i las (《 zha 》+ ci ) bgyis pa thams cad so sor bshags shing yang mi bgyid do/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/ des sdig pa rnams bsrabs shing dag par 'gyur ba lags/

da dge ba'i rtsa ba spel ba'i don du rjes su yi rang ba bgyid pas 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pas bsdus ∶pa/(《 zha 》 pa'i rang ) gzhan gyi dge ba thams cad la rjes su yi rang snyam du bsgoms la lad mo mdzod cig phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ so so'i skye bo dang*/ 'phags pa nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la dga' zhing rjes su yi rangs bar bgyi'o/ /des rang gi rgyud la dge ba'i rtsa ba dpag tu med pa 'phel bar 'gyur ba lags/ da sems can rnams smin cing grol bar bgyi ba'i don du/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul bar bgyid pas/ rang gi lus dpag tu med par sprul nas/ sems can thams cad dang thabs cig tu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyan sngar phyin nas/ gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa la sogs pa yon du phul nas chos gsung bar zhu bar bsgoms la lad mo mdzod cig phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ gang dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na rnam par bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mi bzhed pa de dag thams cad la/ sems can thams cad smin cing grol bar bgyi ba'i slad du/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul lo zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /de ltar bskul bas sangs rgyas rnams kyis chos ston par 'gyur ba'i dge ba rang re rnams kyis thob par 'gyur ba lags/ da chos kyi 'khor lo de rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung bar bya ba'i don du mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs pa lags pas/ yang rang gi lus dpag tu med par sprul pa dang*/ sems can thams cad dang thabs cig tu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyan sngar phyin te/

mchod pa'i tshogs rnams kyis mchod nas/ 'khor ba rgyun ma chad kyi bar du mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs par zhu snyam du bsgoms la lad mo mdzod cigaphyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ gang dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na rnam par bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'da' bar dgongs pa de dag thams cad la/ 'khor ba srid du mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs nas sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad par gsol ba 'debs so zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /de ltar gsol ba btab pas sangs rgyas rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs nas sems can rnams kyi don mdzad par 'gyur ba'i dge ba rang re rnams kyis thob par 'gyur ba lags/ da dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag chud mi 'dza' bar bya ba'i don du cho ga'i rim pa tshang bar bya'i phyir bsngo ba bgyid pas dge ba thams cad yongs su bsngo snyam bgyis la lad mo mdzod cig phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag gis de ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag gi mthus/ bdag cag gi rgyud la byang chub kyi sems skye ba dang*/ mthar phyin par gyur cig ces lan gsum brjod/ de ltar bdun po des sbyor ba'i cho ga yan lag bdun pa tshang ba lags/ da dngos gzhi bgyid pa lags/ de la thog mar bsam pa sbyang ba dang*/ bsam pa 'byongs nas dam 'cha' ba gnyis yod pa lags/ de la thog mar bsam pa sbyang ba bgyi bas bdag zer ba bzhin bsgom par zhu/ bdag gi lus dang*/ longs spyod dang

| dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad sems can thams cad la byin pas/ sems can re re kyang yongs su rdzogs par thob nas sdig pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral/ dge ba dang bde ba phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan/ myur du 'tshang rgya ba'i rgyur 'gyur bar bsgom par zhu/ des bsam pa sbyang ba lags/ de ltar bsam pa 'byongs nas dam 'cha' ba lags pas | sngon gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis (《 zha 》+ ji ltar ) byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du/ bdag gis kyang sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i lam rnams la rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi snyam du bsgoms la lad mo mdzod cig phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas de dag gis sems can thams cad la phan par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ grol bar bya ba'i phyir dang*/ mu ge med par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bya ba'i phyir/ smon pa dang 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can gyi byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du/ bdag gis kyang sems can thams cad la phan par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ grol bar bya'i phyir dang*/ mu ge med par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bya ba'i phyir/ smon pa dang 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can gyi byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /de ltar sbyor ba dang dngos gzhi gnyis kyi sgo nas khyed rnams kyis byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa thob pas/

spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems bskyed gyur na skad cig gis/ /'khor ba'i btson rar bsdams pa'i nyam thag kun/ /bder gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya zhing*/ / 'jig rten lha mir bcas pas phyag byar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyal ba rnams kyi sras byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya bar 'gyur zhing*/ myur du 'tshang rgya ba'i skal ba dang ldan/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten dang*/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang phyag bya ba'i gnas su 'gyur ba lags/ da 'jug gi cho ga la gnyis bdog pa'i thog mar rang dga' ba bsgom par bgyi bas | bdag byang chub sems dpar gyur pa shin tu don che/ da rigs dang mthun pa'i spyod pa la ci nas kyang bslab dgos snyam du bsgoms la lad mo mdzod cig∶de ring (《 zha 》 deng dus ) bdag tshe 'bras bu yod/ /mi yi srid pa legs par thob/ /de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to/ /da ni bdag gis ci nas kyang*/ /rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsam ste | | skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la/ /rnyog par mi 'gyur te ltar bya/ /de rang dga' ba bsgom pa lags/ da gzhan dga' ba bsgom du gzhug par bgyi bas | bdag cag gis sems bskyed pa thob cing*/ byang chub sems dpar gyur pas bstan pa la dga' ba'i lha la sogs pa thams cad dga' bar gyis la/ bdag byang chub bsgrub pa'i grogs kyang mdzod ces bskul bar bsgoms la/ bdag gis de ring skyob pa thams cad kyi/ /spyan sngar 'gro ba bde gshegs nyid dag gi /bar du bde la mgron du bos zin gyis/ /lha dang lha min la sogs dga' bar gyis/ /zhes brjod do/ /de ltar sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi sgo nas byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa yongs su rdzogs pa thob pa lags/ de'i bslab par bya ba la nus tshad kyis sdig pa mi byed/ dbang med bya dgos byung na bshags pa bya/ stong pa dang snying rje zung du 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/

sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya snyam du byang chub kyi sems rgyun du bsgom pa'i bslab par bya ba gal che ba rnams 'du ba lags par gda' | rgyas par gzhan du mkhyen par mdzad 'tshal/ da dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad chud mi 'dza' zhing mthar phyin par bya ba'i don du bsngo ba bgyi bas/ rang gzhan gyis byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad bsam pa rnam par dag pas bsdus nas sems can thams cad dang thun mong du sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur bsngo snyam du bsgoms la lad mo mdzod cig phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba gzhan thams cad gcig tu bsdoms nas sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig de ma thob kyi bar du skye ba dang srid pa thams cad du lha dang mi'i go 'phang phun sum tshogs pa thob par gyur cig yang dag pa'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis rjes su bzung nas don dam pa dang kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems zung du 'jug pa rgyud la skyes te pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang*/ bsdu ba'i dngos po rnam pa bzhi spyad nas/ sa bcu dang lam lnga bgrod de myur du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig 'jam dpal dpa' bos ji ltar mkhyen pa dang*/ /kun tu bzang po de yang de bzhin te/ /de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag slob cing*/ /dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo/ /gnas skabs su'ang bdag cag thams cad tshe ring ba dang*/ nad med pa dang*/ longs spyod che ba dang*/ bsam pa thams cad chos bzhin du 'grub pa dang shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig/ // ༄༅/ /skyabs sems bsngo ba dang bcas 'bring du bstan pa bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo

| | spy-ir bstan pa'i gzhi skyabs su 'gro ba yin zhing bye brag tu theg pa chen po'i lam gyi gzhi byang chub tu sems bskyed pa yin pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya ba'i tshul ni sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi rjes gsum dgos pa yin/ sbyor ba la sdig pa dag par bya ba dang*/ bsod nams spel bar bya ba gnyis yin | de la thog mar sdig pa bshags pa byed dgos/ de la slob dpon zhi ba lhas | bdag ni sdig pa ma byang bar/ /sngon du gum par 'gyur du mchi/ /ji ltar 'di las nges thar ba/ /myur ba'i tshul gyis bskyab tu gsol/ /zhes gsungs pas/ sdig pa ma byang ba'i sngon du shi na ngan song du ltung zhing mtha' med pa'i 'khor bar 'khyam dgos pas shin tu 'jigs pa yin pas sdig pa 'dag dgos/ de'i thabs bshags pa yin/ de ltar bshags pa byed pa la stobs bzhi tshang dgos pas/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum sprin gtibs pa bzhin du bzhugs pa bsgom/ de la rang nyid brten par bsgom pa rten gyi stobs yin/ de'i spyan sngar rang gis byas pa'i sdig pa la gnong zhing 'gyod pa'i sems bsgom/ de rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs yin/ phyin chad lus dang srog gi phyir yang sdig pa mi bya snyam du bsgom pa de/ slar bsdam pa'i stobs yin/ sdig pa mi byed pa'i steng du dge ba nus tshad kyis dang du blang snyam du bsam pa de/ gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs yin/ de ltar bsgoms la ngag tu 'di skad ces/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag gis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug gi dbang gis lus dang ngag dang yid kyi sgo nas sdig pa mi dge ba'i las ci bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du stsal ba dang*/ bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba de dag thams cad so sor bshags shing yang mi bgyid do/

/ zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /de ltar bshags pa byas pas sdig pa thams cad 'dag par 'gyur ba yin te/ sdig pa yod pa dang*/ de bshags pas 'dag ∶pa (《 zha 》 par gsungs pa ) thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis gsungs pas | shin tu lkog tu gyur pa'i don la sangs rgyas kyi lung tshad ma yin pa'i phyir ro | | de nas dge ba'i rtsa ba spel ba ni/ 'bad pa med cing yo byad la ma ltos par thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par gyis dge ba'i rtsa ba spel ba'i phyir thabs rjes su yi rang ba yin pas/ rang gis byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la dga' ba bsgom(《 zha 》+ zhing ) / gzhan gyis byas pa'i dge ba sangs rgyas kyi rgyud la mnga' bas zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba nas bzung ste/ ngan song gi rgyud la yod pa'i bsod nams rgyu mthun gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba'i bar/ phyogs bcu dus gsum dang rjes su 'brel pa thams cad la shin tu rjes su yi rangs | bdag kyang 'di lta bu'am de bas lhag pa cig grub na ci ma rung snyam du bsams la/ 'di skad ces/ so so'i skye bo dang*/ 'phags pa nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag thams cad la dga' zhing rjes su yi rang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes brjod do/ /de ltar rjes su yi rang ba las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba mtha' yas pa yin te/ sdud pa las/ stong gsum ri rab srang la gzhal bas tshad bzung rung*/ /rjes su yi rang dge ba de ni de lta min/ / zhes gsungs so/ /de rnams ni skyabs su 'gro ba'i sbyor ba'i cho ga yin no/ / dngos gzhi skyabs su 'gro ba dngos la bdag dang sems can thams cad thog ma med pa nas 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal gyis yun ring du gdungs/ da dung yang tha ma med pa na yun ring du sdug bsngal ∶myong bar gdon mi za bas(《 zha 》 'gyur bas ) / 'jigs pa 'di las skyob pa'i yul dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum yin pas/
